anchors.description: Seven-brick run along one cream stretcher course of the banded brick facade (right building), from a brick head joint at (968,639) to a head joint at (1054,639), same horizontal course.
anchors.visible_evidence: Both endpoints sit on visible brick head joints of the same cream stretcher course: head joints repeat at ~12.3 px spacing across x=968..1054 (7 modules) at y~639, immediately left of the ground-floor window jamb at x~1056.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic masonry, no model plate; assumed European 240 mm brick + 10 mm joint = 0.25 m module (0.22-0.26 m plausible), and count uncertainty of about one brick.

anchors.description: Freestanding black steel litter bin with slanted lid at the left wall base; vertical extent from the top of the lid down to its base on the pavement.
anchors.visible_evidence: The bin is a distinct freestanding object at the wall base: slanted lid with a litter slot, tapering body standing directly on the gravel pavement; its top and base are fully visible, about 82 px tall.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Unbranded street litter/ashtray bin; typical installed heights 0.85-1.15 m, lid slope adds a few percent to the top-to-base line.

anchors.description: Backless metal bench running along the left wall: seat-bar top surface at the first steel leg, measured down to the pavement at that leg's foot.
anchors.visible_evidence: The black seat bar is clearly visible with a thin steel leg descending from it to a foot plate on the gravel; seat top at y~713 and ground at the same x at y~749, about 36 px.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic long outdoor bench; seat height standard 0.38-0.48 m, local image scale uncertain so the stated interval is widened.
